_comment: MOMENTS (Milestone 5¾; docs/tasks.md, docs/channel.md §25): what a viewer collects for each kind of moment they watched live while the tab showed, kept in their browser, never a sim input. kinds: one moment each, levelling up through steps (counts; the first step is 1), in groups for the AUDIENCE pane's MOMENTS tab; name on the wall, seen and first on its page and the notice; byTeam the counts by team on its page (goals by the scoring team; whole matches by both teams, and wins). Stops (Tom, 2026-10-13): every tackle and block seen (STATS' BLOCKS, STEALS and TACKLES, both teams: the Quell's stat), about 76 a match; stopsMatch, a whole match with that many or more, a secret (about 1 in 60). The steps were set from npm run moments (Tom, 2026-10-12). short: the first step's row on its page, and row the name in the others' (25 MATCHES), where the usual words won't keep to one line. secrets: once and done (Tom), shown as ? until found; how says what it was. places: what SEEN IT ALL needs opened at least once, as the channel names them: SIDE:<tab>, <pane title>:<tab>, CARD:PLAYER, CARD:TEAM:<tab>, LEVELS, BROADCAST. A tab renamed must be renamed here too, or the secret can't be found.
